spots.summary: Campus Martius Park is a re-established park in Downtown Detroit, Michigan. spots.summary: Located in one of Detroit's poorest neighborhoods known as Black Bottom, Tyree Guyton founded the Heidelberg Project in 1986. It is an outdoor museum that consists of a two block area with houses that are decorated to look colorful and intriguing. Guyton started the project to take the neighborhood from a hard core inner-city neighborhood to a safe place where visitors are welcomed.

The building was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1975.
